messages:
sara: Heads-up: API design decision needed for multi-trigger fallback policies — who owns runtime validation vs console UX? @mark @toni
mark: I think platform should own the contract. UX owns how it's surfaced in console. runtime validates shape + semantics.
toni: Agree. UX needs a sanitized subset for the console so we don't expose raw conditions. Also need preview for 'what-if'.
raj: Technical ask: we need deterministic evaluation order for triggers. If two triggers fire, which degrade mode wins?
sara: Good q. proposal: explicit priority int, default = 100. Lower wins. If equal, fallback to tie-breaker: most-recently-updated.
mark: Priority field is fine. Also add 'exclusive' flag so some triggers suppress downstream ones.
raj: Pseudo-API sketch:
```json
{
  "triggers": [
    {"id":"t-1","type":"error_rate","threshold":0.05,"priority":50,"exclusive":true},
    {"id":"t-2","type":"latency_p50","threshold_ms":500,"priority":100}
  ],
  "degrade_mode": "serve_cached"
}
```
toni: UX note: if 'exclusive' hides other triggers, console must show suppressed triggers and why. Audit log must record suppression reason.
sara: Auditability: store event refs pointing to request ids and the evaluated trigger set. retention 90d by default, enterprise opt-in for 365d.
mark: Implementation detail: runtime should return an 'applied_policy_snapshot' in response header for troubleshooting.
raj: Concern: header length. Maybe return a short policy id and provide an API /policy-history/{id} for full snapshot.
sara: Yep. Also need a dry-run endpoint so customers can simulate a request against policy set. => POST /policy/simulate
toni: And for console, a 'policy simulator' that can run sample traces and show why a trigger fired. That will reduce support load.
deploy-bot: Reminder: there's a canary scheduled tomorrow 03:00 UTC for the routing changes. :rocket: 
mark: Quick question on defaults: should failure-to-evaluate (null) count as trigger false or trigger true? Prefer false.
raj: Agree false. But add 'safe_fail_mode' per-policy: safe=false|true so enterprise can choose.
sara: :thumbsup: I'll update the API proto and open a short RFC. Anyone want to pair on the simulator mockups later today?
toni: I can jump on in 2pm PT. dropping a quick figma link: https://figma.com/s/pol-sim
mark: I'll sketch server contract and a minimal header format. ping me if you need me on the RFC.
sara: Thanks all. filing notes.
